articles.summary: We are thrilled to announce that Meter Feeder has been featured on GovTech Biz's list of "companies on our radar this week." This recognition highlights our innovative approach and significant contributions to the tech and government sectors.
articles.title: Meter Feeder Featured on GovTech Biz's "Companies on Our Radar This Week"

articles.summary: In the second quarter of 2024, Meter Feeder's innovative Ticket Monitor service has proven its worth by uncovering thousands of previously undetected parking tickets for fleet operators. This discovery has led to significant cost savings and improved operational efficiency, particularly for delivery companies.
articles.title: Ticket Monitor Uncovers Thousands of Hidden Parking Tickets, Saving Fleets Big in Q2 2024
